name: ai-assisted-tools
description: AI tools for academic research built on Claude: Claude Code plugins for turning methods papers into tested skills and for auditing simulation studies against reporting guidelines.

plugins.name: skill-generator
plugins.description: Turn a manuscript, methods paper, framework, guideline, or tutorial into a tested Claude Code skill with a design brief, a paired benchmark against a no-skill baseline, and a usage guide.

plugins.name: stress-rep-guideline
plugins.description: Audit a DES, system dynamics, agent-based, or hybrid simulation write-up against the STRESS reporting checklist (Monks et al. 2019), item by item with quoted evidence.
